description: Each weekday at a set time, one line per Xero bank account: its balance at the close of the previous business day (Friday on a Monday), its balance today, and the movement between them - the same figures as the Bank Balance Change tile. The report goes to Reports as a web page, is filed in Knowledge as a PDF under Banking/Reports, and is emailed as an attachment to the people picked. Read-only in Xero.

nodes.code:
# ── Draw the bank balance report - one line per account - put it in Reports, file the PDF and email it ── import base64 import io import re from datetime import date from typing import Any from fpdf import FPDF from PIL import Image MAIL = "m365-mail-send" FOLDER = "Banking/Reports" MONTHS = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"] # The masthead logo. Taller than this and it crowds the rule beneath; wider and it reaches the title block. LOGO_H = 11.0 LOGO_W = 60.0 # The whole PDF is base64'd into the mail connector's request, and a logo straight out of a design tool can # be megabytes. It is drawn 11mm tall, so a few hundred pixels is every pixel it can show. LOGO_PX = (960, 240) LOGO_BYTES = 120_000 NAVY = (22, 37, 64) GOLD = (176, 141, 87) GREEN = (29, 115, 80) RED = (176, 44, 44) INK = (33, 37, 41) GREY = (110, 114, 120) LINE = (222, 220, 214) PAPER = (244, 242, 237) WHITE = (255, 255, 255) def safe(s): """Core PDF fonts are Latin-1 only.""" s = str(s or "") for a, b in (("–", "-"), ("—", "-"), ("‘", "'"), ("’", "'"), ("“", '"'), ("”", '"'), ("•", "-"), ("…", "..."), ("→", "->"), ("·", "-"), ("▲", "+"), ("▼", "-"), ("≈", "~"), (" ", " ")): s = s.replace(a, b) return s.encode("latin-1", "ignore").decode("latin-1") def esc(s): return (str(s or "").replace("&", "&").replace("<", "<").replace(">", ">") .replace('"', """)) def d_fmt(iso): """dd-Mmm-yy, for the file name and the email subject.""" if not iso: return "" y, m, d = iso[:10].split("-") return d + "-" + MONTHS[int(m) - 1] + "-" + y[2:] def money(n): return "A$" + format(abs(float(n or 0)), ",.2f") def tone_rgb(direction): return GREEN if direction == "up" else (RED if direction == "down" else GREY) def tone_css(direction): return "#1d7350" if direction == "up" else ("#b02c2c" if direction == "down" else "#6e7278") def moved(account): return abs(float(account.get("difference") or 0)) >= 0.005 change = params.get("change") or {} problem = str(params.get("problem") or "") business = str(params.get("business_name") or "").strip() # The Xero organisation the figures were read from, straight from the connector. business_name is free text # someone typed, so it can name any org; this cannot. org_name = str(params.get("org_name") or "").strip() source_line = "Xero organisation: " + org_name if org_name else "Xero organisation not identified" head = change.get("summary") or {} accounts = change.get("accounts") or [] # -- Who gets it --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Three ways of saying who, and the report goes to all of them at once: a workspace group, one person, and # any addresses typed in. Picking people beats typing addresses - a group keeps up with who joins and leaves, # and nobody mistypes an address that then bounces where no one sees it. to = [] lost = [] people = {} group_id = str(params.get("email_group") or "").strip() user_id = str(params.get("email_user") or "").strip() if group_id or user_id: try: for person in api.users.list() or []: people[str(person.get("id") or "")] = person except Exception as exc: lost.append("couldn't read the workspace users (" + str(exc).replace("tool_error: ", "")[:120] + ")") wanted = [] if group_id: try: members = api.groups.members(group_id=group_id) or [] except Exception as exc: members = [] lost.append("couldn't read the group's members (" + str(exc).replace("tool_error: ", "")[:120] + ")") for member in members: wanted.append(str((member.get("user_id") or member.get("id") or "") if isinstance(member, dict) else member)) if user_id: wanted.append(user_id) for who in wanted: found = people.get(who) or {} if found.get("email"): picked = str(found.get("email")).strip() if picked.lower() not in [x.lower() for x in to]: to.append(picked) elif who: lost.append("someone picked has no email address on their profile") for typed in str(params.get("email_to") or "").replace(";", ",").split(","): picked = typed.strip() if picked and picked.lower() not in [x.lower() for x in to]: to.append(picked) # Said once, however many people it happened to: the point is that the list is short, not who is missing. lost = sorted(set(lost)) lost_note = (" Some recipients were left off: " + "; ".join(lost) + ".") if lost else "" # The business's logo, where one has been put in Knowledge. A logo that will not load is said so in the # summary and the name is set instead - a missing picture is no reason to lose the report. logo_file = str(params.get("logo_file") or "").strip() logo_path = "" logo_uri = "" logo_size = (0, 0) logo_note = "" if logo_file: try: with open(str(api.files.get(file=logo_file)), "rb") as fh: img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(fh.read())) img.load() img.thumbnail(LOGO_PX) buf = io.BytesIO() img.save(buf, format="PNG", optimize=True) kind, ext = "image/png", ".png" if buf.tell() > LOGO_BYTES and img.mode in ("RGB", "L"): buf = io.BytesIO() img.save(buf, format="JPEG", quality=85, optimize=True) kind, ext = "image/jpeg", ".jpg" logo_raw = buf.getvalue() logo_size = img.size logo_path = api.files.scratch_path("logo" + ext) with open(logo_path, "wb") as fh: fh.write(logo_raw) logo_uri = "data:" + kind + ";base64," + base64.b64encode(logo_raw).decode("ascii") except Exception as exc: logo_path = "" logo_uri = "" logo_note = " The logo was left off: " + logo_file + " wouldn't load (" + \ str(exc).replace("tool_error: ", "")[:120] + ")." report_file = "" report_link = "" emailed_to = "" sent = "" filed = "" if problem or not accounts: summary = problem or "Nothing to report." else: today = date.today().isoformat() title_name = business or org_name or "Bank Balances" # -- Drawing helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- pdf = FPDF(format="A4", unit="mm") pdf.set_auto_page_break(False) pdf.set_margins(0, 0, 0) pdf.c_margin = 0 L = 14.0 CW = 182.0 TOP = 16.0 BOTTOM = 276.0 def font(size, style: Any = "", color=INK): pdf.set_font("Helvetica", style, size) pdf.set_text_color(*color) def label(x, y, text, color=GREY, size=6.5): font(size, "B", color=color) pdf.set_char_spacing(0.6) pdf.text(x, y, safe(str(text).upper())) pdf.set_char_spacing(0) def rule(y, color=LINE, width=0.2, x=L, w=CW): pdf.set_draw_color(*color) pdf.set_line_width(width) pdf.line(x, y, x + w, y) def write(x, y, w, text, size=8.0, lh=3.8, color=INK, style="", align="L"): font(size, style, color=color) pdf.set_xy(x, y) lines = pdf.multi_cell(w, lh, safe(text), align=align, dry_run=True, output="LINES") for i, ln in enumerate(lines): pdf.set_xy(x, y + i * lh) pdf.cell(w, lh, ln, align=align) return y + len(lines) * lh def fit(text, w, size, style: Any = ""): pdf.set_font("Helvetica", style, size) t = safe(text) if pdf.get_string_width(t) <= w: return t while t and pdf.get_string_width(t + "...") > w: t = t[:-1] return t.rstrip() + "..." def masthead(first): pdf.add_page() if not first: label(L, TOP, title_name + " - bank balances", color=GREY) rule(TOP + 2.5, color=LINE) return TOP + 9.0 y = TOP if logo_path and logo_size[0]: w = min(LOGO_W, LOGO_H * logo_size[0] / logo_size[1]) pdf.image(logo_path, x=L, y=y, w=w, h=w * logo_size[1] / logo_size[0]) else: font(15, "B", color=NAVY) pdf.text(L, y + 8, fit(title_name, CW * 0.55, 15, "B")) font(13, "B", color=NAVY) pdf.set_xy(L, y) pdf.cell(CW, 7, safe("BANK BALANCES"), align="R") font(8, "", color=GREY) pdf.set_xy(L, y + 6.5) pdf.cell(CW, 4, safe(str(head.get("subtitle") or "")), align="R") font(6.5, "", color=GREY) pdf.set_xy(L, y + 10.3) pdf.cell(CW, 3.5, safe(source_line), align="R") rule(y + 14, color=NAVY, width=0.6) return y + 20.0 # A cursor walked down the page, taking a new one whenever the next row will not fit. page = [1] y_now = [0.0] def need(h): if y_now[0] + h <= BOTTOM: return page[0] += 1 y_now[0] = masthead(False) y_now[0] = masthead(True) # -- Total across the accounts ------------------------------------------------------------------------- total_dir = str(head.get("totalDirection") or "flat") pdf.set_fill_color(*PAPER) pdf.set_draw_color(*LINE) pdf.set_line_width(0.2) pdf.rect(L, y_now[0], CW, 20, style="DF") label(L + 6, y_now[0] + 7, "Total change across " + str(head.get("accountCount") or len(accounts)) + (" account" if (head.get("accountCount") or len(accounts)) == 1 else " accounts")) font(18, "B", color=tone_rgb(total_dir)) pdf.text(L + 6, y_now[0] + 16, safe(str(head.get("totalDifferenceText") or ""))) # The closing balances added up. On a page that is only balances, the one figure that isn't on any row # is the one the reader does in their head otherwise. held = sum(float(a.get("balance") or 0) for a in accounts) font(7.5, "", color=GREY) pdf.set_xy(L, y_now[0] + 8) pdf.cell(CW - 6, 4, safe("Held across all accounts"), align="R") font(12, "B", color=NAVY) pdf.set_xy(L, y_now[0] + 12) pdf.cell(CW - 6, 5, safe(money(held)), align="R") y_now[0] += 26 # -- One row per account ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- c_prev, c_bal, c_chg = 42.0, 42.0, 38.0 c_name = CW - c_prev - c_bal - c_chg label(L, y_now[0], "Account", size=6) label(L + c_name, y_now[0], "Previous close", size=6) label(L + c_name + c_prev, y_now[0], "Balance today", size=6) font(6, "B", color=GREY) pdf.set_char_spacing(0.6) pdf.set_xy(L, y_now[0] - 2.4) pdf.cell(CW, 3.6, safe("CHANGE"), align="R") pdf.set_char_spacing(0) y_now[0] += 2.2 rule(y_now[0], color=NAVY, width=0.4) y_now[0] += 4.2 for a in accounts: need(11) name = str(a.get("name") or "") direction = str(a.get("direction") or "flat") font(9, "B", color=INK) pdf.set_xy(L, y_now[0]) pdf.cell(c_name, 4.4, fit(name, c_name - 3, 9, "B")) font(9, "", color=INK) pdf.set_xy(L + c_name, y_now[0]) pdf.cell(c_prev, 4.4, fit(str(a.get("previousBalanceText") or ""), c_prev - 3, 9)) font(9, "B", color=INK) pdf.set_xy(L + c_name + c_prev, y_now[0]) pdf.cell(c_bal, 4.4, fit(str(a.get("balanceText") or ""), c_bal - 3, 9, "B")) font(9, "B", color=tone_rgb(direction) if moved(a) else GREY) pdf.set_xy(L, y_now[0]) pdf.cell(CW, 4.4, safe(str(a.get("differenceText") or "") if moved(a) else "no change"), align="R") # The day the previous balance is the close of, under the figure it belongs to. Bank accounts are # not all fed on the same day, and a stale one looks exactly like a quiet one without this. font(6.5, "", color=GREY) pdf.set_xy(L + c_name, y_now[0] + 4.2) pdf.cell(c_prev, 3.2, fit(str(a.get("previousDayText") or ""), c_prev - 3, 6.5)) pdf.set_xy(L + c_name + c_prev, y_now[0] + 4.2) pdf.cell(c_bal, 3.2, fit(str(a.get("todayText") or ""), c_bal - 3, 6.5)) if moved(a): pdf.set_xy(L, y_now[0] + 4.2) pdf.cell(CW, 3.2, safe(money(a.get("moneyIn")) + " in / " + money(a.get("moneyOut")) + " out"), align="R") y_now[0] += 9.0 rule(y_now[0] - 1.4, color=LINE) # -- Footer, on the last page --------------------------------------------------------------------------- rule(285, color=LINE) font(6.5, "", color=GREY) pdf.set_xy(L, 286.5) pdf.cell(CW * 0.7, 3.5, safe(str(head.get("updatedText") or "From Xero bank transactions"))) pdf.set_xy(L, 286.5) pdf.cell(CW, 3.5, safe("PAGE " + str(page[0]) + " OF " + str(page[0])), align="R") # -- The same report as a web page for Reports ----------------------------------------------------------- h = ["", esc(title_name), " - Bank Balances
"] h.append("" if logo_uri else "

" + esc(title_name) + "

") h.append("

BANK BALANCES

" + esc(str(head.get("subtitle") or "")) + "
" + esc(source_line) + "
") h.append("
Total change across " + esc(str(head.get("accountCount") or len(accounts))) + " account" + ("" if (head.get("accountCount") or len(accounts)) == 1 else "s") + "
" + "
" + esc(str(head.get("totalDifferenceText") or "")) + "
" + "
Held across all accounts
" + "
" + esc(money(held)) + "
") h.append("" "") for a in accounts: direction = str(a.get("direction") or "flat") h.append("" + "" + "" + "") h.append("
AccountPrevious closeBalance todayChange
" + esc(str(a.get("name") or "")) + "" + esc(str(a.get("previousBalanceText") or "")) + "" + esc(str(a.get("previousDayText") or "")) + "" + esc(str(a.get("balanceText") or "")) + "" + esc(str(a.get("todayText") or "")) + "" + (esc(str(a.get("differenceText") or "")) + "" + esc(money(a.get("moneyIn")) + " in / " + money(a.get("moneyOut")) + " out") + "" if moved(a) else "no change") + "
") h.append("
" + esc(str(head.get("updatedText") or "")) + "
Balances only - the transactions behind them are in the bank transaction detail report." "
") page_html = "".join(h) # -- Save and send --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- data = bytes(pdf.output()) clean = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9 ._-]+", " ", title_name)).strip() or "Bank" title = clean + " Bank Balances " + d_fmt(today) report_file = FOLDER + "/" + title + ".pdf" path = api.files.scratch_path("balances.pdf") with open(path, "wb") as fh: fh.write(data) api.files.put(file=report_file, scratch_file=path) # Reports shows HTML, not PDFs, so the page goes up as HTML there and the PDF stays the copy that is # filed in Knowledge and emailed. html_path = api.files.scratch_path("balances.html") with open(html_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh: fh.write(page_html) try: # The bridge would derive "text/html; charset=utf-8" from the .html name, and the artifact manager # rejects a mime carrying a ";" (it is echoed into a Content-Type header), so name it plainly here. made = api.artifacts.put(title=title, scratch_file=html_path, file_name=title + ".html", kind="document", visibility="tenant", mime_type="text/html", description="Bank balances across " + str(len(accounts)) + " Xero bank account(s), with the change since the previous business day.", tags=["bank balances", "xero"]) report_link = str((made or {}).get("url") or "") if isinstance(made, dict) else "" except Exception as exc: filed = ", but couldn't put it in Reports (" + str(exc).replace("tool_error: ", "")[:200] + ")" else: filed = " to Reports" if to: lines = ["Hi,", "", "Attached are today's bank balances" + (" for " + org_name if org_name else "") + ".", ""] for a in accounts: lines.append("- " + str(a.get("name") or "") + ": " + str(a.get("balanceText") or "") + (" (" + str(a.get("differenceText") or "") + " since " + str(a.get("previousDayText") or "") + ")" if moved(a) else " (no change)")) lines += ["", "Held across all accounts: " + money(held) + ".", "It's in Reports" + (" at " + report_link if report_link else "") + ", and filed in Knowledge at " + report_file + ".", "The figures come straight from Xero. The transactions behind them are in the bank " "transaction detail report."] try: api.connectors.invoke(server=MAIL, tool="send_email", args={ "to": to, "subject": "Bank balances: " + money(held) + " held, " + str(head.get("totalDifferenceText") or "") + " (" + d_fmt(today) + ")", "body": "\n".join(lines), "attachments": [{"name": title + ".pdf", "contentBase64": base64.b64encode(data).decode(), "contentType": "application/pdf"}], }) emailed_to = ", ".join(to) sent = " and emailed it to " + emailed_to except Exception as exc: sent = ", but couldn't email it (" + str(exc).replace("tool_error: ", "")[:200] + ")" else: sent = " (nobody was picked to receive it, so it wasn't emailed)" summary = "Saved " + report_file + filed + sent + "." + logo_note + lost_note

nodes.summary: Draws one line per account - previous close, balance today, movement - as both a web page and a PDF, puts the web page in Reports, files the PDF in Knowledge as Banking/Reports/<name> Bank Balances <date>.pdf, and emails it to the people picked.
nodes.title: Write the balance report and email it

params.description: Which Xero organisation to report on. Part of the name is enough - "irvine" finds Irvine Jackson Pty Ltd. Leave it blank to use whichever organisation the connection defaults to. An automation does not follow the organisation picker on your dashboard, so if the report names a different organisation than the Bank Balance Change tile, put the tile's organisation here. If what you type matches no connected organisation, or more than one, the run stops and names the ones it found rather than reporting on the wrong books.
params.label: Xero organisation
params.name: xero_org

params.description: A workspace group whose members all get the report. The list keeps up with the group, so nobody has to remember to add a new starter or take a leaver off.
params.label: Send to group
params.name: email_group

params.description: One person in the workspace who gets the report, on top of the group.
params.label: Send to person
params.name: email_user

params.description: Any other addresses, for people outside the workspace. Separate several with commas. Leave all three blank and the report is still saved to Reports and Knowledge, but nothing is emailed.
params.label: Other email addresses
params.name: email_to

params.description: Shown at the top of the report. Leave it blank to use the Xero organisation's own name. Either way the report names the Xero organisation the figures came from.
params.label: Name on the report
params.name: business_name

params.description: Optional. A logo in Knowledge to put at the top of the report, for example Automations/logo.png.
params.label: Logo file
params.name: logo_file
